blocks.text: Billy Crawford joined the voice cast members of the French version of DreamWorks Animation’s animated film “Forgotten Island,” lending his voice to demon baby Bungi. Crawford attended the film’s premiere event in Paris and spoke about how the film represents Filipino culture, as seen in a clip by One Filipino TV shared on the actor-performer’s Instagram page on Thursday, Oct. 1. During the event, he also noted that it was his first time dubbing an animated film.
